summary: Scheduled warmup credits not applied after multi-region maintenance leading to provisional negative balance
description: Issue summary: Customer BrightRetail reports that the scheduled warmup job that runs nightly to pre-warm model KV caches did not result in the expected 'warmup' credits being applied for two hourly windows spanning a DST boundary. Impact: provisional invoice shows a negative balance (-$1,420) for the account on 2026-03-09 provisional billing; customer is concerned about unexpected charge and wants credit applied. Environment: Dedicated deployment, hybrid fallback enabled, primary region us-east-1, failover region eu-west-1. Steps to reproduce: 1) BrightRetail runs scheduled warmup job at 02:30 local each day (cron configured in customer scheduler). 2) On 2026-03-09 maintenance was performed affecting edge proxies in eu-west; scheduler retried warmup across regions. 3) Billing postbacks show warmup-meter events but no reserve-warmup credits credited to tenant ledger. Observed behavior: postbacks exist (postback IDs provided below) but reconciler applied them to a transient tag (staging->prod tag rename race) causing credits to be orphaned. Expected behavior: warmup credit lines should have been applied to the customer's account and offset warmup costs, leaving provisional invoice zeroed for the warmup intervals. Logs/IDs: postback IDs pb-2026-03-09-00523, pb-2026-03-09-01201; scheduler job id warmup-job-rt-401; reconciler trace id rc-77f3a. Additional context: Customer uses reserved hourly buffer; they have a negotiated rate override that complicates allocation rules. They paused autopay pending resolution.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel (Support): Opened ticket with initial bill snapshot attached and postback IDs from customer. Notified billing and SRE. Asked for preliminary triage and whether we can grant provisional credit pending reconciliation.

2026-03-10 - Billing (Elena Rodriguez): Confirmed provisional negative balance. Checked billing ledger and saw entries for warmup charge lines but no corresponding credit entries. Marked as P2 and requested reconciler logs.

2026-03-11 - Customer (Samir Gupta, BrightRetail): Provided cron config and confirmation that job retried automatically during EU maintenance window; customer requests urgent provisional waiver to avoid collection action.

2026-03-11 - Marcus Lee (SRE): Reconciler logs show tag rename collision at 2026-03-09T02:34:12Z; postbacks mapped to tag 'prod-staging-mux-991' which is orphaned. Added hypothesis: tag mapping service TTL expired during concurrent maintenance and reconciler fallback assigned a transient tag.

2026-03-12 - Billing (Elena Rodriguez): Agreed to apply provisional ledger credit of $1,420 pending final reconciliation. Noted this will be reversed if postbacks are later reattributed to another tenant. Customer notified of provisional credit and hold on autopay.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Lee (SRE): Created PR to add idempotency checks to tag-mapping path and to add a reconciliation batch that re-runs allocations for the affected window. PR linked in ticket. Scheduled out-of-band repro run against staging reconciler cluster.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Tag-mapping race during edge maintenance caused reconciler to apply postbacks to a transient tag; credits became orphaned and never flowed to customer's ledger. Evidence: reconciler trace rc-77f3a shows 'tag_lookup: miss -> create-temporary'; subsequent postbacks referenced that temp tag. Hypothesis 2: DST boundary combined with cross-region retries produced duplicate postback timestamps that confused the hour-binning logic. Evidence: timestamps in pb-2026-03-09-00523 and pb-2026-03-09-01201 differ by 1h but both map to same hour in local cron timezone. Actions taken: downloaded reconciler logs, pulled postback database rows, ran allocation simulator locally (script: tools/alloc-sim) to validate credit routing. Found 12 orphaned credit rows with tag 'prod-staging-mux-991' and no parent org_id. Next steps: run reconciler re-attribution job for 2026-03-09 02:00-04:00 window, deploy PR to add idempotency guard, add regression test for DST+retry case. Related artifacts: dashboard link https://grafana.redwood/board/postback-reconciler; PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/postback-reconciler/pull/492.
resolution: Workaround applied: Billing applied a provisional ledger credit of $1,420 on 2026-03-12 and suspended autopay for BrightRetail until reconciliation completes. Permanent fix: SRE to run re-attribution job to move orphaned credits to tenant ledger (scheduled for 2026-03-13 03:00 UTC), and merge PR to add idempotency and TTL checks to tag-mapper (PR #492). Post-mortem actions: add a regression test to reconciler CI for DST + cross-region retry, update runbook to include a check for tag TTL during maintenance windows, and notify customers of potential warmup credit edge cases during multi-region maintenance. Customer follow-up: Send summary email with provisional credit details and expected finalization timeline. Ticket will be updated to Resolved after re-attribution job completes and final invoice reconciled.
